svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SPI timing of one 24-bit frame
svg.desc: SPI timing of the AS5047U in mode 1: CSn low frames a 24-bit frame, the chip changes MISO after each rising CLK edge and reads MOSI on each falling edge, with the select, clock, setup and output times of the datasheet.
svg.text: SPI mode 1 (CPOL 0, CPHA 1). Datasheet: SPI Timing, Figure 19, p. 17; SPI
Interface (Slave), p. 16; SPI Transaction, Figures 23 to 25, p. 19.
CSn falling edge to the first CLK rising edge
MOSI valid before the CLK edge that reads it
CLK edge to MISO data valid
Last CLK falling edge to CSn rising edge
CSn rising edge to MISO high impedance
CSn high time between two frames
tL and tCSn come from synchronization with the internal clock: 2 ×
tCLK_SYS + 10 ns, the system clock being 9 MHz typical. The chip runs
a command at the end of the frame, on the rising edge of CSn.
